conditional_DID.law: P(G,H)=(1/8,3/8,3/8,1/8) when enumerated (G1H0,G1H1,G0H0,G0H1); independent fair eps. All baseline outcomes zero. Untreated outcome change1+2H+eps; treatment effect2+2H. P(G1)=1/2.
conditional_DID.population_DR_remainder: E[(p-p_tilde)/(1-p_tilde)*(m0-m_tilde)]/pi; prove by conditional expectation, finite-cell inference separately.

event_study.effects: All untreated outcomes zero; early cohort effects1,3,7;late effect2;no anticipation.
event_study.regression: Equal-row-weight unit and time FE plus every observed event dummy except-1; within5x5Gram is nonsingular.
event_study.method: Independent rational double demeaning and Gaussian elimination. Full mean table; finite coefficient arithmetic does not itself assert causal effects.
event_study.scope: These values require exactly this declared set of leads/lags and normalization; no reuse under different binning or omitted categories.

anticipation.not_yet_adoption4_at3: With anticipation effect2 atdate3, its outcome5 is already affected although treatment indicator stillzero; using it instead of never-treated controls gives3. Eligibility requires first treatment>t+a.

known_Gaussian_projection.sampling_contract: Bivariate reduced-form estimator is exactly Gaussian with known marginal SD1/5 each; independent coordinates may be used. Population preeffect iszero, baseline departure0, departure restriction abs(delta_post)<=Mbar*abs(beta_pre), Mbar1.
known_Gaussian_projection.proof: Each coordinate fails with probabilityalpha/2; union bound gives jointcoverage>=1-alpha. On that event all true reduced-form coordinates and the allowed true departure are among the projected pairs. Rectangle extrema attain displayed endpoints. A plug-in sensitivity interval ignores uncertainty in pretrend and post reduced forms.
known_Gaussian_projection.scope: A directly proved finite known-Gaussian construction, not the general uniformly asymptotic HonestDiD procedure.

author_independent_confirmation_2026_10_.author_confirmation: Independent eight-atom law, full OLS residual Gram, four-comparison operator, sensitivity vertices and known-Gaussian projection agree with root blueprint. DR remainder uses the actual treated share pi in both terms; arbitrary working-odds renormalization is not the same functional.
author_independent_confirmation_2026_10_.limits: Retain explicit anticipation eligibility, cohort composition, compact sensitivity fibers and known-Gaussian confidence scope.
